column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key identifying each environment and health record (e.g., 'ENVH0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), linking environment/health data to an event (e.g., 'DIST0001').
An enum (EnvImpactRate_enum) rating environmental impact; values: 'Low', 'High', 'Medium'.
An enum (WasteManagementState_enum) describing waste management capability; values: 'Adequate', 'Limited', 'Critical'.
A NUMERIC(4,1) capturing the recycling rate percentage (e.g., 10.5).
A DECIMAL(10,3) counting carbon emissions in tons (e.g., 250.000).
A NUMERIC(5,2) logging what percent of energy usage is renewable (e.g., 15.50).
A NUMERIC(7,3) representing sanitation coverage percentage (e.g., 92.500).
An enum (DiseaseRisk_enum) for disease outbreak threat; values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'.
An enum (MedicalEmergencyCapacity_enum) capturing medical emergency readiness; values: 'Adequate', 'Critical', 'Limited'.
A DECIMAL(6,3) showing percent of population vaccinated (e.g., 85.200).
An enum (MentalHealthAid_enum) measuring mental health support; values: 'Limited', 'Available'.
